## Diagnostics

After the issue, choose **Save diagnostics**. If the app closed, the automatic report is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DungeonsInputStudio\diagnostics\last-session.json`.

Review the report before attaching it. Do not upload the backups folder, game saves, or memory dumps. Reports stay local until you choose to share them. Multiplayer behavior is not yet validated; reports help identify its limitations.
